title: CONTAM 3.4 User Guide and Program Documentation
publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology

license.name: United States government work; CONTAM public-domain documentation

units.airflow: kilogram per second or cubic metre per second as declared by the report
units.contaminant_concentration: mass fraction or user-selected display concentration

measurement_uncertainty.description: The registered material documents equations, numerical methods, and software behavior rather than measured validation data.

known_gaps: CONTAM supports pressure, wind, buoyancy, fans, ducts, and directional flow paths that the NexusEP prescribed-flow model does not solve.
No CONTAM project result is registered in this phase, so no comparative-validation result is claimed.
A future comparison must align volumes, prescribed flows, source terms, initial concentrations, and integration settings before calibration is considered.

preprocessing.description: Verify the exact public NIST CONTAM user-guide PDF by signature, byte size, and SHA-256 without creating a derived dataset.

permitted_use.purpose: Equation verification and scoped comparative-validation planning for airflow and contaminant transport
permitted_use.notes: The source is a United States government publication and CONTAM is public-domain software. NexusEP still requires source attribution for scientific traceability.
